name: Balaam
overview: Balaam, a soothsayer and prophet from Mesopotamia, was summoned by Balak, king of Moab, to curse the Israelites who had come out of Egypt and settled near his land. Despite Balak's request and the rewards offered, Balaam's journey was marked by divine intervention, as God’s anger was kindled against him and an angel of the Lord blocked his path, leading to a remarkable encounter involving Balaam’s donkey. These events reveal Balaam's complex role as a prophet whose actions and counsel would later contribute to Israel's moral corruption and highlight the sovereignty of God over human intentions.
